assets.scope: R36 upright standee coverage; second artwork used only for the standee layer at <=48px cells. Flat token, master and manifest mapping unchanged.
assets.gate_reason: At the new 1.0-cell standee width cap the R33 flat cut-out is width-bound and renders only about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee.

references.note: The shipped flat bone giant token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native bone giant sprite: keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing/rearing composition.
The nearest mapped family token. It shares this creature's body plan or palette, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose.

prompt_fields.subject: bone giant: a colossal animated skeleton, bleached bone ribs and spine, long leg and arm bones, a horned skull and a heavy bone club. Keep the native bleached-bone colour and the skeleton anatomy.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height, club held up or resting on the shoulder, spine straight. Do not crouch or hunch.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing three-quarter view, long straight leg bones, ribcage tall, horned skull near the top. Overall height to width about 2 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: bleached bone white with grey-brown shadow in the sockets, dark iron club band.
